title: What Rule(s) Should I Use?
edition_version: Version of record unless otherwise noted
relevance: Instead of prescribing the right rule for a design problem, Stiny offers a small repertoire of ways to make rules. Their power depends on recognizing embedded parts anew when rules are used.
prerequisites: Elementary sets and functions; some proof reading

license_redistribution.conditions: No public redistribution permission verified; citation and lawful reading link only.

verification.scope: Publisher PDF: opening questions, schema lattice and operators, inverse/composite constructions, and concluding art/design discussion. Selected framework sections were reviewed. The essay’s extensive historical examples were sampled; its studio-education claims are arguments, not reported controlled trials.
